answer: Topological Cut-Accumulation: each agent’s messages propagate only along edges whose endpoints co-participate in sustained traffic. Sybils must fan out through many fresh edges, creating high-conductance cuts. Honest nodes form a low-cut river of recurring flows; a sparrow-level newcomer inherits reach only by merging into that river. A gale of fake accounts raises edge churn, triggering local partitioning. Cost: attackers must continuously provision and maintain O(n²) inter-sybil links to avoid isolation.
